overview: You looked at the three sheets and added nothing. The prison was not begun. The end was not begun. The sheets stayed on the board. You did not put them in the coffer.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the last lines and added none.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Looked at the three sheets and went to the almanac

summary: Looked at the three sheets and went to the almanac
